### Main Map Component File

### Full Map Component Contents

The map.tsx file contains a complete map system with the following exported components:

1. **`Map`** - Main map container component
   - Supports theme detection (light/dark modes)
   - Uses CartoDB basemaps by default (configurable)
   - Viewport control (center, zoom, bearing, pitch)
   - Supports 3D globe projection
   - Default loader animation while map initializes
   - Imports: `maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css`

2. **`MapMarker`** - Individual marker placement
   - Longitude/latitude positioning
   - Draggable support with callbacks
   - Click, mouse enter/leave, and drag event handlers

3. **`MarkerContent`** - Custom marker content wrapper
   - Supports custom JSX or default blue dot icon
   - CSS class customization

4. **`MarkerPopup`** - Interactive popup on marker
   - Shows/hides on click
   - Close button support
   - Customizable offset and max-width
   - Uses React portals for DOM rendering

5. **`MarkerTooltip`** - Hover-based tooltip on marker
   - Shows on mouse enter, hides on mouse leave
   - Automatic positioning
   - Dark background styling (foreground/background colors)

6. **`MarkerLabel`** - Text label above/below marker
   - Position options: 'top' (default) or 'bottom'
   - Centered alignment with transform

7. **`MapControls`** - Control buttons for map interaction
   - Zoom in/out buttons
   - Compass reset button (shows bearing/pitch)
   - Locate button (uses geolocation API)
   - Fullscreen toggle
   - Customizable positioning (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right)

8. **`MapRoute`** - Line/path drawing
   - GeoJSON-based line rendering
   - Configurable color, width, opacity, dash pattern
   - Click and hover event handlers
   - Interactive cursor feedback

9. **`MapClusterLayer`** - Point clustering visualization
   - GeoJSON FeatureCollection support
   - Three-tier color clustering (small/medium/large)
   - Configurable thresholds and colors
   - Click handlers for clusters and individual points
   - Auto zoom to cluster on click

### Theme Detection System

The map includes sophisticated theme detection:
- Document class detection (dark/light)
- System preference detection (prefers-color-scheme)
- MutationObserver for theme changes
- MediaQueryList listener for system theme changes
- Default CartoDB styles:
  - Dark: `https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/dark-matter-gl-style/style.json`
  - Light: `https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/positron-gl-style/style.json`

740	function MapControls({

749		const { map } = useMap();

772						};

774							center: [coords.longitude, coords.latitude],

848	function CompassButton({ onClick }: { onClick: () => void }) {
849		const { map } = useMap();

852		useEffect(() => {

867			return () => {

905	function MapPopup({
906		longitude,
907		latitude,
908		onClose,
909		children,
910		className,
911		closeButton = false,
912		...popupOptions
913	}: MapPopupProps) {
914		const { map } = useMap();
915		const popupOptionsRef = useRef(popupOptions);
916		const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose);
917		onCloseRef.current = onClose;
918		const container = useMemo(() => document.createElement('div'), []);
919	
920		const popup = useMemo(() => {
921			const popupInstance = new MapLibreGL.Popup({
922				offset: 16,
923				...popupOptions,
924				closeButton: false,
925			})
926				.setMaxWidth('none')
927				.setLngLat([longitude, latitude]);
928	
929			return popupInstance;
930			// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
931		}, []);
932	
933		useEffect(() => {
934			if (!map) return;
935	
936			const onCloseProp = () => onCloseRef.current?.();
937	
938			popup.on('close', onCloseProp);
939	
940			popup.setDOMContent(container);
941			popup.addTo(map);
942	
943			return () => {
944				popup.off('close', onCloseProp);
945				if (popup.isOpen()) {
946					popup.remove();
947				}
948			};
949			// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
950		}, [map]);
951	
952		if (popup.isOpen()) {
953			const prev = popupOptionsRef.current;
954	
955			if (popup.getLngLat().lng !== longitude || popup.getLngLat().lat !== latitude) {
956				popup.setLngLat([longitude, latitude]);
957			}
958	
959			if (prev.offset !== popupOptions.offset) {
960				popup.setOffset(popupOptions.offset ?? 16);
961			}
962			if (prev.maxWidth !== popupOptions.maxWidth && popupOptions.maxWidth) {
963				popup.setMaxWidth(popupOptions.maxWidth ?? 'none');
964			}
965			popupOptionsRef.current = popupOptions;
966		}
967	
968		const handleClose = () => {
969			popup.remove();
970		};
971	
972		return createPortal(
973			<div
974				className={cn(
975					'bg-popover text-popover-foreground animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 relative rounded-md border p-3 shadow-md',
976					className,
977				)}
978			>
979				{closeButton && (
980					<button
981						type="button"
982						onClick={handleClose}
983						className="ring-offset-background focus:ring-ring absolute top-1 right-1 z-10 rounded-sm opacity-70 transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:outline-none"
984						aria-label="Close popup"
985					>
986						<X className="h-4 w-4" />
987						<span className="sr-only">Close</span>
988					</button>
989				)}
990				{children}
991			</div>,
992			container,
993		);
994	}

1352				e: MapLibreGL.MapMouseEvent & {
1353					features?: MapLibreGL.MapGeoJSONFeature[];
1354				},
1355			) => {
1356				if (!onPointClick || !e.features?.length) return;
1357	
1358				const feature = e.features[0];
1359				const coordinates = (feature.geometry as GeoJSON.Point).coordinates.slice() as [
1360					number,
1361					number,
1362				];
1363	
1364				// Handle world copies
1365				while (Math.abs(e.lngLat.lng - coordinates[0]) > 180) {
1366					coordinates[0] += e.lngLat.lng > coordinates[0] ? 360 : -360;
1367				}
1368	
1369				onPointClick(feature as unknown as GeoJSON.Feature<GeoJSON.Point, P>, coordinates);
1370			};
1371	
1372			// Cursor style handlers
1373			const handleMouseEnterCluster = () => {
1374				map.getCanvas().style.cursor = 'pointer';
1375			};
1376			const handleMouseLeaveCluster = () => {
1377				map.getCanvas().style.cursor = '';
1378			};
1379			const handleMouseEnterPoint = () => {
1380				if (onPointClick) {
1381					map.getCanvas().style.cursor = 'pointer';
1382				}
1383			};
1384			const handleMouseLeavePoint = () => {
1385				map.getCanvas().style.cursor = '';
1386			};
1387	
1388			map.on('click', clusterLayerId, handleClusterClick);
1389			map.on('click', unclusteredLayerId, handlePointClick);
1390			map.on('mouseenter', clusterLayerId, handleMouseEnterCluster);
1391			map.on('mouseleave', clusterLayerId, handleMouseLeaveCluster);
1392			map.on('mouseenter', unclusteredLayerId, handleMouseEnterPoint);
1393			map.on('mouseleave', unclusteredLayerId, handleMouseLeavePoint);
1394	
1395			return () => {
1396				map.off('click', clusterLayerId, handleClusterClick);
1397				map.off('click', unclusteredLayerId, handlePointClick);
1398				map.off('mouseenter', clusterLayerId, handleMouseEnterCluster);
1399				map.off('mouseleave', clusterLayerId, handleMouseLeaveCluster);
1400				map.off('mouseenter', unclusteredLayerId, handleMouseEnterPoint);
1401				map.off('mouseleave', unclusteredLayerId, handleMouseLeavePoint);
1402			};
1403		}, [isLoaded, map, clusterLayerId, unclusteredLayerId, sourceId, onClusterClick, onPointClick]);
1404	
1405		return null;
1406	}
1407

1410		useMap,
1411		MapMarker,
1412		MarkerContent,
1413		MarkerPopup,
